articleTitle: Disc Replacement vs. Microdiscectomy: What It Means When Your Surgeon Skips the Smaller Surgery
imageHeadline: Why Your Surgeon Skipped the Smaller Back Surgery
imageSubtext: What it means when microdiscectomy won't work and disc replacement is recommended
pinTitle: Disc Replacement vs. Microdiscectomy: When the Conservative Surgery Isn't an Option
pinDescription: Your surgeon says microdiscectomy won't work for your herniated disc and recommends disc replacement instead. Learn what that decision is based on—degree of degeneration, disc height loss, re-herniation risk—and the specific questions to ask about your imaging, recovery timeline, and surgical experience before you decide.
